title: Budaya & Adat Malaysia
canDo: Discuss Malaysian festivals and customs respectfully
Navigate multicultural etiquette (Malay, Chinese, Indian, indigenous)
Understand sensitivities around religion and race
lifeBenefit: Build genuine cultural fluency and avoid social missteps in Malaysia's multicultural context.

vocab.example: Perayaan apa yang paling awak suka?
vocab.exampleEn: Which festival do you like the most?

vocab.example: Kami buat rumah terbuka Hari Raya tahun ni.
vocab.exampleEn: We're having an open house for Hari Raya this year.

vocab.example: Penting untuk hormat adat orang lain.
vocab.exampleEn: It's important to respect others' customs.

vocab.example: Isu agama dan kaum agak sensitif di sini.
vocab.exampleEn: Religion and race are fairly sensitive topics here.

vocab.example: Toleransi antara kaum penting untuk perpaduan.
vocab.exampleEn: Tolerance between ethnic groups is important for unity.

practiceExercises.prompt: Translate: 'Are you going to any open house for Hari Raya?'
practiceExercises.answer: Awak nak pergi rumah terbuka Hari Raya tak?

practiceExercises.prompt: Translate: 'I always ask if the food is halal, out of respect for customs.'
practiceExercises.answer: Saya sentiasa tanya kalau makanan tu halal, sebagai tanda hormat adat.

scenario.setting: Being invited to a Hari Raya open house and asking respectful questions

script.ms: Jom datang rumah terbuka kami Hari Raya nanti!
script.en: Come to our Hari Raya open house!

script.ms: Wah, terima kasih jemput! Ada apa-apa adat yang saya patut tahu?
script.en: Wow, thank you for the invitation! Is there any custom I should know?

script.ms: Just datang je, pakai baju sopan, dan makanan semua halal.
script.en: Just come, wear modest clothing, and all the food is halal.

script.ms: Baik, saya akan hormat adat tu. Boleh saya bawa sesuatu?
script.en: Alright, I'll respect that custom. May I bring something?

script.ms: Tak payah, datang je dah cukup!
script.en: No need, just coming is enough!

scenario.aiPrompt: You are a Malaysian friend inviting the learner to a Hari Raya open house. Answer their respectful questions about etiquette warmly and simply, reflecting genuine Malaysian hospitality norms.

speakingPrompts.instructions: Shadow the open-house invitation dialogue, focusing on warm, hospitable tone.
Respond to an invitation from the AI friend persona and ask one respectful question about etiquette.
Give a 2-minute talk describing a festival or custom from your own culture, comparing it briefly to a Malaysian one.

questions.prompt: Translate: 'It's important to respect other people's customs.'
questions.answer: Penting untuk hormat adat orang lain.
